name: Blåkläder
verdict: Owned by the Gustavsson family's AB Blåkläder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Family-owned Swedish workwear maker (est. 1959, Svenljunga); own factories in Sri Lanka, Myanmar and Bangladesh, ~8,000 employees. Sleeve and main partner of Schalke 04 from 2026/27. No sourced human-rights finding against the company found.
